newsitem.title: CANADA: Saskatchewan Pool pleased with shares.
newsitem.headline: Saskatchewan Pool pleased with shares.

text.p: Canada's largest grain handling firm said on Wednesday it was pleased with the performance of its shares in their first year of trade on Canadian equities markets.
"I am pleased with our share performance as well as the support shown by Pool members and investors," Saskatchewan Wheat Pool President Leroy Larsen said in a statement.
SWP class B non-voting shares opened on the Toronto Stock Exchange on April 2, 1996 at 13.125. The year high was 20.95 on November 18.
SWP closed at 17.25 in Toronto on Wednesday.
The company said it believed being added to the TSE 300 Composite Index on February 21 "will attract additional investors."
